purpose: Per capability slot: the wired adapter, the candidate primary external repo, the fallback, the stub that keeps the system running with zero deps, and the contract proofs that any replacement must keep green. If an upstream repo becomes unmaintained, this is the documented swap path — replace the adapter, keep the slot's I/O contract + proofs.
rule: Every active/candidate slot must declare a primary candidate + at least one fallback-or-stub + at least one contract proof. foil/reference slots are exempt (never adopted).
